blocks.text_bn:
অজু করি। হাত-মুখ ধুই।
আম খেয়েছি। আম মিষ্টি।

অজু একটি কাজের নাম।
আম একটি ফলের নাম।

অ — অজু, অলি, অজগর
আ — আম, আতা, আকাশ

image_slots.scene_description: অ-এর ছবি: অলি (মৌমাছি) একটি ফুলের উপর — objects/animal-first, একক প্রাণী, কোনো মানুষ নেই। পরিষ্কার সাদা ব্যাকগ্রাউন্ড, বর্ণ-শিখি স্পটলাইট।
image_slots.compliance_note: single bee on a flower; story-critical detail (the bee) kept centre-frame, clear of lower third where the programmatic stripe lands; high-contrast line-art for B/W. No stripe language in prompt.
image_slots.prompt: A clean, friendly children's-textbook illustration of a single honeybee resting on one open flower, centred, on a plain white background. Simple bold outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects. High contrast and clear linework so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: অজগর — একটি অজগর সাপ কুণ্ডলী পাকিয়ে আছে, একক প্রাণী, নিরীহ ভঙ্গি। বর্ণ-শিখি স্পটলাইট।
image_slots.compliance_note: single coiled python, calm posture; body kept in upper two-thirds so the stripe lands on plain ground, not on the animal's head; high-contrast line-art for B/W.
image_slots.prompt: A gentle children's-textbook illustration of a single coiled python resting calmly on plain ground, centred, on a plain white background. Friendly, non-threatening expression, simple bold outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects. High contrast and clear linework so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: আম — দুই-তিনটি আম একটি ডালে ঝুলছে, object-only, কোনো প্রাণী/মানুষ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only slot; ripe mangoes on a branch; no stripe needed (no living being).
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of two or three ripe mangoes hanging from a leafy branch, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.compliance_note: object-only slot; single custard-apple; no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a single custard-apple (আতা) fruit with a small leaf, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: আকাশ — খোলা আকাশে কয়েকটি মেঘ ও একটি সূর্য, scenery-only, কোনো প্রাণী/মানুষ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: scenery-only slot; open sky with clouds and sun; no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of an open sky with a few soft clouds and a friendly sun, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects, no birds. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: অজু — object-only: একটি বদনা/লোটা ও পানির ধারা, ওযুর প্রতীক, কোনো মানুষ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only slot; water jug (বদনা) with a stream of water symbolising অজু; no figure, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a traditional water jug (badna) pouring a small stream of water over an open hand-basin, centred, on a plain white background. Object-focused, no people. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: বর্ণ-লিখন ট্রেসিং অ্যাসেট — অ ও আ, স্ট্রোক-তীরসহ (NCTB মূল)। AI-জেনারেটেড নয়; ভেক্টর অ্যাসেট থেকে অ্যাসেম্বলিতে বসবে।
image_slots.compliance_note: letter-tracing grid for অ and আ with stroke-order arrows; vector asset, never AI-generated.

lessons.notes: পাঠ ১০ বর্ণ-শিখি: অ আ (🔒 স্থির). Title + letters + পড়ি/লিখি structure untouched. action=retain-curated / S1: single vocab swap অশোক→অজু (C-08) — Principal-APPROVED 2026-07-18; plus two extra named picture-examples per letter added as an 'আরও শব্দ' oral strip. Word provenance (map-first): আ set (আম/আতা/আকাশ) all from C1-BAN_word_map_by_letter. অ set — map yields only অলি after dropping অশোক, so অজু + অজগর are memory-sourced fillers (no other অ-initial word exists in the map); flag for reviewer that these two are outside the book's own word inventory. Taught inventory at পাঠ ১০ = অ, আ only (no consonants, no কার): ALL spotlight/sentence words (অজু, আম, অলি, অজগর, আতা, আকাশ) are named picture-examples marked oral:true → letter-audit EXEMPT by design (this is how NCTB বর্ণ-শিখি pages work; the named example need not be decodable). Only decodable/NCTB blocks are the two letters অ/আ themselves (b10/b12), NCTB-original → exempt + trivially in-inventory. অজু spelling chosen over in-book ওযু specifically because অ-initial is required for the অ-page; FLAG for reviewer: in-book spelling inconsistency vs পাঠ ৬ 'ওযু করি' — অজু spelling Principal-APPROVED 2026-07-18 (use অজু). In-book note: differs from পাঠ ৬ 'ওযু করি'; reviewer/আলিম may reconcile at book-level QA, but অজু stands for this page. Skeleton hint 'আম→আম্মা' NOT usable (আম্মা needs ম+্ম conjunct+কার, untaught at পাঠ ১০) — treated as loose illustration only. Images: অ→অলি(bee)/অজগর(python) as single-animal generate_stripe (story-critical animal kept clear of stripe zone); আ→আম/আতা/আকাশ object/scenery-only; অজু→object-only বদনা (no human figure, avoids C-01/C-05 entirely); tracing = vector_asset, prompt='' permanently. No cast figures on this page → refs empty, same-gender rule n/a. MERGE HELD: পাঠ ১০ is ahead of unbuilt ৭–৯; per user, updated JSON with ৭–৯ to be uploaded before this merges in NCTB order.
